description: Expected results for the official WSIMOD quickstart demo (docs/demo/examples/quickstart_demo.yaml with docs/demo/data/processed/timeseries_data.csv, ImperialCollegeLondon/wsi git 2f55314). One Land node (10 urban + 100 rural area units, Oxford land forcing 2009-03-03..2013-02-25, 1456 daily steps), sewer, groundwater, river node and outlet. inputs/ are the unmodified files from the wsi git tree. The upstream test (tests/test_example_files.py) only checks that flows/tanks/surfaces.csv are written, so there are no official reference numbers; the values below were recorded from real runs on this server. Two clean runs through the KI run tool and one run through the official `python -m wsimod` CLI gave byte-identical flows.csv, tanks.csv and surfaces.csv (deterministic).

numeric_checks.name: n_timesteps
numeric_checks.why: one step per unique date in timeseries_data.csv (2009-03-03..2013-02-25)

numeric_checks.name: n_tank_records
numeric_checks.why: 5 tanks (sewer, 3 land tanks, groundwater) x 1456 steps

numeric_checks.name: outlet_flow_sum
numeric_checks.why: total flow on catchment_outflow arc to the outlet (main model output)

numeric_checks.name: storm_outflow_sum
numeric_checks.why: total sewer storm outflow (sewer capacity 0.04 limits it)

numeric_checks.name: precipitation_total
numeric_checks.why: rain on both surfaces (forcing mm->m times area); checks forcing was read and scaled

numeric_checks.name: final_groundwater_storage
numeric_checks.why: groundwater storage on the last day

numeric_checks.name: final_rural_surface_storage
numeric_checks.why: rural soil storage on the last day

numeric_checks.name: water_balance_residual
numeric_checks.why: rain - evaporation - outlet flow - end storage (all tanks + surfaces, start storage 0) must close

recorded_with: KI tools/run_wsimod.py --mode api with PYTHONPATH=<wsi repo source>, /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/python_env/bin/python
reference: No official reference outputs ship with this demo. Upstream tests/test_model.py::TestModel::test_run builds the same network for one day with hand-set inputs and asserts outlet flow 0.05 and urban storage 0.03; that test was also run on this server and passed (not part of this package).
notes: Run finishes in about 1 s. No changes were made to the inputs; the output folder from the yaml (results/quickstart_results) is replaced by the --outputs argument, which is the official CLI option for this.
